description: This Java interface defines a client for sending messages to Hono's southbound Telemetry and Event APIs, with multiple overloaded send methods supporting different payload types and properties.

classes.name: DownstreamSender
classes.description: An interface extending MessageSender, providing methods to send messages with various payloads and properties to devices via Hono's APIs.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message to a device with specified payload and content type, returning a Future indicating the operation's outcome. Overloaded to accept String, byte[], and properties with payload.
